releaseNotes: Fix the Pinggy backup tunnel (blank-password sign-in, new free.pinggy.io host and URL detection) and prefer it over the throttled localhost.run, so customer uploads go through on networks that block Cloudflare quick tunnels. Storefront moved to printaway-ten.vercel.app (QR links, admin links and updater). Uploads no longer hang: the station leaves a throttled localhost.run tunnel for Pinggy automatically, and the website uploads in 512 KB parts with progress, timeouts and retries. Multi-document orders with previews, auto-crop and a sticky pay bar.
